title: fix(app-shell): stop the highlightFields help promising a cap of four
body:
Fixes #8413

## What the help said, and what the code does

Studio's settings panel (`ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx:310`) told authors:

> Highlight fields (highlightFields) — default list columns, cards and detail header take the first 4; order is display order

That is a **universal** claim. It is true on two surfaces and false on five.

⚠️ **Cite the census, not a `slice(0, 4)` grep.** A bare `slice\(0, *4\)` regex has many unrelated hits, and the narrow probe "does `highlightFields` co-occur with `slice`" returns **zero** — but that zero is a *probe-shape artefact*, not a reading: every real cap is applied to a **renamed derived variable** (`declared`, `ordered`) ten-plus lines downstream. A lit control lit on that probe anyway. The only thing that sees it is reading all eight consumers.

### The eight read sites

**No cap on a declared list (5)** — the declared list is used in full:

| Site | Undeclared fallback |
|---|---|
| `app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx:106-110` default list columns | `.slice(0, 6)` |
| `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:540-544` default list columns | `.slice(0, limit)`, `limit` defaults 5, **both callers pass 5** |
| `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:2892-2913` grid default columns | every visible field, **no cap** |
| `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx:118-127` kanban card fields | filtered, no cap — a surface the old help never named |
| `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:2023-2031` detail header | declared list minus title field; undeclared fallback is **4** |

**Caps a declared list (3):**

| Site | Cap | Called with the default by |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:438-459` `deriveHighlightFields(def, statusField, max = 4)` | **4** | `anchors.ts:208`, **`PagePreview.tsx:243` (Studio's own page preview)**, `RecordDetailView.tsx:380`, plus internal `:638` / `:773` |
| `fields/src/widgets/deriveLookupColumns.ts:67-87` `max = 4` | **4** | `LookupField.tsx:429` (every picker with `lookup_columns` unauthored), `RelatedList.tsx:465` |
| `plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:1097-1104` | **6** (`maxColumns`, `:338`) | — |

Runtime measurement, with a lit control: `deriveHighlightFields` fed **6** declared returns **4**; fed **3**, returns **3** — so the 4 is a binding cap, not a constant. `deriveLookupColumns` fed 6 returns 4.

## Why this wording

The failure mode is silent and points **downward**: an author who believes the cap writes four and loses fields on all five uncapped surfaces, with nothing reporting a problem. (One measured victim: ats#33.)

The new strings **name no number and enumerate no surface**:

> Highlight fields (highlightFields) — the most important fields on this object, in display order; surfaces that show a record at a glance draw on them, each taking as many as it has room for

> 重点字段(highlightFields)—— 本对象最重要的字段,顺序即展示顺序;需要概览展示一条记录的界面都从中取用,各自能放下多少取多少

⛔ The card's originally suggested replacement was **not** adopted — it carries two fresh false claims: "All declared fields are used" (falsified by the three capping surfaces) and "Undeclared, the first 6 business fields are taken instead" (falsified by `ObjectView`'s 5 and the detail header's own 4). Swapping one falsifiable list for another is the disease this card treats.

Both locales change in the same commit, so a Chinese-UI author is not left sizing lists to a cap that never existed.

The undeclared case is untouched here on purpose: the sibling string `engine.studio.settings.undeclared` ("(not declared — surfaces pick heuristically)" / "(未声明 —— 各处按启发式自动挑选)", rendered at `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx:349`) already covers it, and already covers it without enumerating.

## Gate verdicts

Each gate's own verdict line; exit codes captured before any pipe.

| Gate | Exit | Verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `check:i18n-keys` | 0 | `Every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack (2985 keys) …` |
| `check:i18n-drift` | 0 | `Compared the ten locale packs at dcbf0b2bc … 0 en value(s) changed` |
| `check:i18n-dead-keys` | 0 | report leg, no new entry |
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 | `✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 7018 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `check:designer-field-key-parity` | 0 | `designer-field-key-parity: OK` |
| changeset presence | 0 | `✅ 1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` |
| changeset no-major | 0 | `✅ No changeset declares a 'major' bump.` |
| closure build (`'@object-ui/app-shell^...'`) | 0 | `Done` |
| `@object-ui/app-shell` build | 0 | `✓ dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete (922 emitted files verified)` |
| `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check | 0 | `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, clean |
| `@object-ui/app-shell` test | 0 | `Test Files 665 passed (665)` · `Tests 6425 passed \| 1 skipped (6426)` |
| `@object-ui/app-shell` lint | 0 | `✖ 2944 problems (0 errors, 2944 warnings)` — 0 errors; warnings pre-existing, none in the changed lines |

Governed-surface check, **with `AGENTS.md` as a lit control on the same command shape**:

```
--test packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts .changeset/olive-doors-tickle.md
  exit 0  ✅ NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.
--test AGENTS.md                    (lit control)
  exit 3  ⛔ GOVERNED — 1 of 1 path(s) are on a governed surface
```
⇒ the control fires, so "not governed" is a reading. This is an ordinary merge-queue PR.

### ⚠️ One acceptance expectation was falsified — measured, not assumed

The dispatch said `check:i18n-drift` **would** name the changed English values and that this was expected. **It does not, and cannot.** The drift gate reads only the ten packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/` (its own verdict line says so: *"Compared the ten locale packs"*). This change is in the metadata-admin **designer table**, which **both repo-wide i18n gates are blind to by construction** — documented at `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs:569-578`. Baseline before my edit and the run after both report `0 en value(s) changed`, and the log mentions `highlightFields` zero times.

Both gates are green, which is what acceptance required — but green because the file was never in scope, **not** because a drift finding was raised and waived. Consequence worth knowing: **nothing mechanically enforces that the `zh-CN` value follows the `en` value in this table.** The "both locales in one change" rule here is discipline with no gate behind it. Satisfied here by hand.

## Pinning decision — deliberately none

⛔ Not pinning the sentence: a string-literal pin only goes red the next time someone rewords it, and protects nothing.

The falsifiable thing is *the help agrees with actual behaviour*, and the honest pin for that is a **caps pin** (this surface caps at 4, that one at 6, these five at none) — it goes red when someone moves a cap without touching the help.

**I am not landing that pin here**, and the reason is specific rather than shy: objectui#8824 exists precisely to decide whether those caps stay as they are, get unified, or get made explicit. A caps pin landing in this PR would encode today's five-way inconsistency as an asserted contract and **fight #8824 the moment it moves anything** — the pin would have to be rewritten by the card that fixes the actual defect. The pin belongs *with* that decision, not ahead of it. Flagged in #8824's acceptance rather than left implicit.

## 验收备注

Observations found while working, none filed, none fixed here — each with its successor:

- **Nothing enforces en→zh-CN value parity in the metadata-admin designer table.** Measured above. Successor: the report on #8413 and #8824's acceptance; it is a gate-coverage question, not a caps question, so it may deserve its own card if #8824's taker does not absorb it.
- **The undeclared fallback differs across the "same" walk**: 6 in `InterfaceListPage.tsx`, 5 in `ObjectView.tsx` (both callers pass `limit=5`), 4 in `deriveHighlightFields`'s own walk (`:569 if (out.length >= max) return out;`) — for code both files describe as deliberately the same. `ObjectGrid`'s comment already records the divergence in writing. Successor: objectui#8824.
- **`deriveHighlightFields` is a published export** of `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`index.tsx:177`) with `max = 4` in its signature, so that cap is part of the published surface, not an internal default. Successor: objectui#8824, which flags it as possibly clause-②.
- **Density**: the card measured five chips truncating two badges (`Pendi…`, `Full-ti…`) at 1440px. Not filed by me; recorded in objectui#8824 and explicitly out of scope here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — Studio 对象设置面板里「重点字段(highlightFields)」那句帮助文案,英文和中文各一句,同一个 commit 改。其余什么都没动:没有加、删、改任何上限,没有碰密度问题。加了一个 patch changeset。

**为什么改** — 旧文案说「取前 4」,是一句普适声称。普查了全部八个消费点,平台对同一个声明列表给了五种待遇:五处不设上限、两处截到 4、一处截到 6。所以那句话在两个表面上是真的、五个表面上是假的。伤害方向朝下且静默:作者信了就只写四个,在五个不设上限的表面上白白少拿字段,而且哪里都不报错。已经有一个实测受害者(ats#33)。新文案不点任何数字、不枚举任何表面,所以下一个消费点也证伪不了它。中文同笔改,否则中文界面的作者会继续按 4 来写。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险很低:改动是两个字符串值,没有代码路径变化,没有导出面变化,类型检查和 665 个测试文件全绿。唯一的实质代价是新文案比旧的**更模糊** —— 作者不再拿到「4」这样一个具体数字,得自己试。这是有意的取舍:一个准确但模糊的说法,好过一个具体但错误的说法。真正的治疗是 objectui#8824(把八处上限统一或显式化),这里只是止血。回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit,没有数据迁移、没有 API 变化、没有下游依赖。

**席位意见** — (留空,待 PM 席位填写)

**你要做的** — 两件事。① 确认新文案的中文读起来自然、且你认可「不点数字」这个方向(这是本卡的核心取舍,由 PM 席位重裁定下)。② objectui#8824 是真正的缺陷卡,需要你裁三件事:八处上限统一还是显式化;若统一统一到什么(注意详情顶栏在 1440px 上确实有密度约束,「无上限」不是显然安全);以及 `deriveHighlightFields` 的 `max = 4` 在已发布签名里,改它算不算条款②。
